q: What material has the lowest speed of sound? 2024
e: Sound travels slowest in gases compared to liquids and solids because gas particles are farthest apart.

q: What does audibility refer to? 2024
a: The quality of being able to be heard
The frequency of a sound wave
e: Audibility refers to the quality or capability of a sound being able to be heard.

q: The intensity of a sound wave is directly proportional to the square of the ____ of the wave. 2024
e: Sound intensity is proportional to the square of its amplitude.

q: Reflection of sound obeys the laws of ____. 2025
e: Reflection of sound follows the standard laws of reflection, where the angle of incidence equals the angle of reflection.

q: What quantity that determines the loudness of sound? 2025
e: Loudness of sound depends directly on the amplitude of the sound wave.

q: If a star is approaching the earth the spectral lines would shift towards ____ end. 2025
e: When a source approaches an observer, the observed light frequency increases towards the blue end of the spectrum.

q: For every 10 dB added to the sound level, the loudness of the sound is increased by ____ times. 2026
e: An increase of 10 dB corresponds to a 10-fold increase in sound intensity.

q: The loudness of the note depends upon the ____ of the wave that produces it. 2025
e: Loudness is determined by the amplitude of the producing sound wave.

q: The speed of sound varies depending on: 2025
a: The shape of the sound wave
e: The speed of sound depends on the properties and state of the medium through which it travels.

q: How does the intensity of a wave I vary with its amplitude A? 2025
e: Wave intensity is directly proportional to the square of its amplitude.

q: Which property of sound determines its loudness? 2025
e: Amplitude is the physical property that dictates sound loudness.

q: The ____ the amplitude, the louder the note. 2025
e: A greater amplitude results in a sound wave carrying more energy, producing a louder note.

q: Which of these effects describes the change in pitch we hear when a fast moving motorbike goes past? 2025
e: The Doppler effect explains the observed shift in frequency/pitch caused by relative motion.

q: What quantity that determines the loudness of sound? 2025
e: Amplitude directly determines the sound loudness.

q: Some portable sound frequency generator can create sound with frequencies 0 Hz to about ____. 2026
e: Standard audio frequency generators cover up to approximately 22 kHz.

q: What value of sound intensity in dB increases by a factor of 100? 2026
e: A tenfold increase in intensity is 10 dB, so a hundredfold increase (10 x 10) corresponds to 20 dB.

q: ____ frequency sounds which are under the lower limit of audibility (20 Hz) are called infrasound. 2025
e: Sound waves with frequencies lower than 20 Hz are classified as infrasound.

q: The Doppler effect is used to measure the ____ of detected objects. 2025
e: The Doppler effect is utilized in radar and sonar systems to determine object velocity.

q: The speed of sound is ____ in solids than liquids and gases. 2026
e: Sound travels fastest in solids due to higher mechanical rigidity and density of the medium.

q: How does the intensity of a wave I vary with its amplitude A? 2026
e: Intensity is proportional to the square of the wave's amplitude.

q: When a source of sound moves away from a stationary observer, the observed frequency of the sound: 2026
a: is greater than the source frequency
is less than the source frequency
is equal to the source frequency
